description:
Initiate a call to a phone number using a specified agent. The
phone number must include a country code with a leading plus.

(Tags: Calls)

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent that will handle the call.

call_context.description: Optional context information as key-value pairs to be passed to the agent during the call. Can contain any custom fields relevant to your use case.

from_number_id.description: Id of a phone number on your account to place the call from (see the phone number list endpoint). Omit to use the platform's default number.

metadata.description:
Key-value pairs stored on the call for your own tracking
(e.g. CRM or lead IDs). Not shared with the agent; echoed
back as `metadata` in the post-call webhook so you can
correlate results with your records.

to_number.description: The phone number to call. Must include country code (e.g., +15551234567).

name: dispatchCall
